architecture: three phases -> reusable capability nodes -> typed methods; problem cases can support multiple capabilities
notes: These are proposed capability definitions; not new stage, method, or genealogy records.
Method IDs listed are illustrative matches, not method-specific empirical validation.
Existing 15 problem.* records describe tasks/applications and remain separate from general capabilities.
General concerns such as physical validity, identifiability, numerical error and uncertainty remain cross-cutting; this catalog describes actionable capabilities.

capabilities.name_zh: 控制方程与物理模型定义
capabilities.name: Physical governing formulation
capabilities.definition: Specify governing equations, variables and model structure rather than choose one numerical solver.

capabilities.name_zh: 参数化与初始边界条件
capabilities.name: Parameterization and boundary conditions
capabilities.definition: Represent unknown coefficients, constitutive laws and admissible boundary/initial conditions.

capabilities.name: Numerical forward simulation
capabilities.definition: Solve ODE/PDE forward dynamics using verified discretization and numerical integration.

capabilities.name: Reduced and surrogate forward modeling
capabilities.definition: Approximate forward solution operators or states for repeated evaluation.

capabilities.name_zh: 灵敏度与可微正向模拟
capabilities.name: Sensitivity and differentiability
capabilities.definition: Compute how predicted states or measurements change with model parameters.

capabilities.name_zh: 观测算子、测量噪声与实验设计
capabilities.name: Observation modeling and design
capabilities.definition: Map latent physical states to data and model sensor configuration and measurement errors.

capabilities.name_zh: 反问题建模与目标函数
capabilities.name: Inverse problem formulation
capabilities.definition: Define unknowns, observation residuals or likelihoods, constraints and solution criteria.

capabilities.name: Identifiability and information analysis
capabilities.definition: Determine what observed data can uniquely or stably constrain about unknown parameters.

capabilities.name: Regularization and priors
capabilities.definition: Stabilize weakly constrained inverse estimates through penalties or probabilistic priors.

capabilities.name_zh: 确定性优化与梯度计算
capabilities.name: Deterministic optimization and gradients
capabilities.definition: Compute point estimates with gradient or derivative-free optimization.

capabilities.name: Posterior inference and computation
capabilities.definition: Approximate conditional distributions and integrals over unknown parameters.

capabilities.name_zh: 仿真驱动与似然自由推断
capabilities.name: Likelihood-free simulation-based inference
capabilities.definition: Infer parameters from synthetic data if the likelihood is intractable but a simulator is available.

capabilities.name: Learned and generative inversion
capabilities.definition: Apply learned inverse mappings, forward surrogates or generative posterior conditioning.

capabilities.name: Model discrepancy and calibration
capabilities.definition: Identify calibration uncertainty that stems from model inadequacy rather than parameters alone.

capabilities.name: State evolution and conditional prediction
capabilities.definition: Roll out individualized dynamical states under known or hypothesized noninterventional conditions.

capabilities.name_zh: 预测不确定性与可靠性验证
capabilities.name: Predictive uncertainty and validation
capabilities.definition: Propagate uncertainty and evaluate reliability of future predictions.

capabilities.name_zh: 反事实模拟与干预效果预测
capabilities.name: Counterfactual intervention simulation
capabilities.definition: Simulate outcomes of modified anatomy, parameters or controlled inputs under explicit physical assumptions.

capabilities.name: Decision optimization and planning
capabilities.definition: Choose actions using predictive models subject to objectives, constraints and safety requirements.

capabilities.name_zh: 长期数据同化与模型更新
capabilities.name: Continual data assimilation and updating
capabilities.definition: Update individual parameters, latent states or model assumptions after follow-up observations.
